tooltip.eternal_defense_displays.insert: Hold a gun and press %s to put it on display.
tooltip.eternal_defense_displays.swap: Press %s with another gun to swap them.
tooltip.eternal_defense_displays.retriev: Right-click with an empty hand to take the gun back.
tooltip.eternal_defense_displays.wall: Needs a solid wall behind every cell.
tooltip.eternal_defense_displays.glass: Guns are shown smaller so magazines clear the glass.
tooltip.eternal_defense_displays.heavy: Two blocks wide, for oversized weapons.
tooltip.eternal_defense_displays.wide: Two blocks wide; both halves share one gun.
tooltip.eternal_defense_displays.tune: Use a Weapon Display Tuner on it to change the gun's size, position and angle.
tooltip.eternal_defense_displays.tuner.u: Right-click a stand that holds a gun to change the gun's size, position and angle.
tooltip.eternal_defense_displays.tuner.k: The settings stay with the stand when you swap guns.
message.eternal_defense_displays.tuner.e: Put a gun on the stand first.
screen.eternal_defense_displays.tuner.re: Back to how the stand shows a gun on its own.
screen.eternal_defense_displays.tuner.co: Remember these settings to paste them on another stand.
screen.eternal_defense_displays.tuner.pa: Use the settings you copied last.
screen.eternal_defense_displays.tuner.hi: Drag a bar or press - and +. Each change shows at once.
